inclusion: Unique exact binomial join within Animalia/Aves lineage, Inference=NO, Complete.measures>=4, positive finite dimensions; cross-lineage homonyms are not joined
split: Reuse species manifest train/validation/test assignments; assert no genus crosses partitions
target_selection: One endpoint selected before any fitting; no SAE activations or generated-image results used

ridge.standardization: Per-coordinate train mean and population SD; zero-variance SD replaced by 1
ridge.objective: mean squared error plus alpha times squared coefficient norm; unpenalized intercept
ridge.selection: Lowest validation MSE; larger alpha wins exact ties

taxonomy_baseline.definition: Training-only family mean shrunk to order mean shrunk to global mean
taxonomy_baseline.selection: Lowest validation MSE; larger total pseudocount wins exact ties

final_fit: Refit both selected models on train+validation exactly once, evaluate untouched test

uncertainty.quantity: taxonomy baseline RMSE minus embedding ridge RMSE
uncertainty.resampling_unit: test genus, with replacement; retain all species in sampled genus

positive_signal_rule: Embedding test R2 > 0 and 95% genus-bootstrap interval for RMSE improvement entirely above 0
interpretation: Predictive association on genera held out from probe fitting, not pretraining novelty, independent anatomical validation, or a causal SAE trait
execution: CPU only; no image generation, SAE fitting, BioCLIP updates or TaxaAdapter updates
